from visits import load_visits, ROWS
from book import VisitBook


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_visits())
    book = VisitBook()
    book.add(rows[0])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1]
    book.add(rows[1])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_total_once():
    book = VisitBook()
    for x in load_visits():
        book.add(x)
    assert book.total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS)

def test_total_after_add():

    book = VisitBook()
    book.add(rows[0])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1]

    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_total_after_every_add():
    book = VisitBook()
    running = 0
    for x in load_visits():
        book.add(x)
        running += x.minutes
        assert book.total() == running


def test_empty_book():
    assert VisitBook().total() == 0


def test_count():

    for x in load_visits():
        book.add(x)
    assert book.count() == len(ROWS)
